chapter.title: Waiting for Hank…
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 from the PowerPyx 100% chart (26 nodes, the [ WAIT FOR HANK ] block, two checkpoints, two endings), the game’s chapter template and string table, and the Fandom wiki (chapter page, Relationship Stat, Software Instability, Public Opinion, Magazine). IN THE ZEN GARDEN → FIND AMANDA (side branches FIND MAGIC STONE, CHECK THE GRAVES) → TALK WITH AMANDA (reaction plus three questions) → ARRIVE AT POLICE STATION → FIND LT. ANDERSON → [ WAIT FOR HANK ] (explore, desk, research, Carlos’ android if saved, Gavin, three magazines, Fowler’s office) beside HANK ARRIVES → HANK STORMS OUT → TALK TO HANK → EXAMINE FILES → TALK ABOUT THE CASE → HANK IS MAD → HANK GOT A LEAD (Kara alive) or HANK LEFT TO GET LUNCH (Kara dead). No probability or timer. Arrows: Amanda (opening reaction −2/+2/−1/−1; FRIENDLY and ADAPT −1, INDIFFERENT +1), Hank (arrival after an Interrogation death −1; DOG and MUSIC +1, BASKETBALL and ANTI-ANDROIDS −1; HANK IS MAD −1, wiki only), software instability (COMPASSIONATE +1), public opinion (break-room TV −1). Cross-chapter: knowsSumo (DOG), the case files read, Carlos’ android’s fate, the ending. Researched in docs/research/chapters/ch12-waiting-for-hank.md; recap in docs/chapters/ch12-waiting-for-hank-chapter-recap.html.

options.label: Deviant not found in Partners
options.effect: Amanda large down (“I must admit I’m a little bit disappointed”).

options.label: Confession, Connor survived
options.effect: Amanda large up (“You’ve been remarkably efficient”).

options.label: Connor died in The Interrogation
options.effect: Amanda small down (“Avoid being destroyed”).

options.label: Found, no confession
options.effect: Amanda small down (“You should have been more cautious”).

decisions.gate: Always; the variant depends on Partners and The Interrogation.
decisions.note: Part of TALK WITH AMANDA. Template, wiki chapter page and Relationship Stat agree on the four arrows.

benchmark.note: Event with the four variants; the arrow (−2, +2, −1, −1) is applied here. A confession followed by a death counts as a death (the template’s “without dying”). Story 1.9.7: Amanda says “the DPD” through the name token, as in the string table (MiKeYROG 100% walkthrough, TqGaB2AE6RM 02:04).
